description: Minimal capability for the main dashboard window (core APIs + dialog + opener for external links such as the About page's project links; custom commands like open_main_window are not ACL-gated). Window permissions below back the self-drawn title bar (minimize / maximize-restore / drag / close). Update execution stays in the panel window on purpose — no updater/process permissions here (the About page reads update state via the cross-window event bridge, see src/updaterEvents.ts).
